MNG 16621, 1.5 Inch Diameter Hobnail Knob

The Hobnail Cabinet Knob features an elegant beaded design. A showstopper, the 1.5 Inch Diameter Hobnail Knob is part of the MNG Vanilla Collection which focuses on simple classics elevated; so just like the world's most popular ice cream flavor, the 1-1/2 Inch Vanilla Thumbprint Knob is stunning in its take on a timeless design.

This cabinet knob is part of the MNG Vanilla Collection.

Specifications and Features of the MNG 166 Hobnail Cabinet Knob:

  • Base Material: Zinc
  • Finish: Satin Antique Nickel
  • Diameter: 1-1/2"
  • Projection: 1"
  • Packaged with 1" long #8-32 screw and 1-1/2" long #8-32 screw.

Sold Individually
